type: spec
domain: TEST
input:
  SRC: src.csv
  OTHER: other.csv
keys: [ID, SECTION]

intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: SELF
    key: {K: K}
    order_by: [SELF.SEQ]
    keep: last
    absent: 0
  - id: F

    key: [K]
    filter: "SECTION = 'first'"
    order_by: [SEQ]
    keep: last
columns:

  - {name: K, type: str, derivation: SRC.K}
  - {name: SEQ, type: int, derivation: SRC.SEQ}
  - {name: V, type: int, derivation: SRC.V}
  - {name: FINAL, type: int, derivation: P.V}
  - {name: FIRST, type: int, derivation: F.V}
rows:
  - id: collected
    dataset: SRC
    derivations:
      SECTION: "'first'"
  - id: grouped
    dataset: SRC
    group_by: [SRC.K]
    derivations:
      ID: "'g'"
      SECTION: "'second'"
      SEQ: 4
      V: "P.V + 10"
  - id: added

    derivations:
      ID: OTHER.ID
      SECTION: "'third'"
      K: OTHER.K
      SEQ: 9
      V: "P.V + 100"

  - PLAN
  - INWIN

  type: str

  derivation: PC.USUBJID

  type: int
  label: Sequence
  derivation: PC.PCSEQ
- name: ADTM
  type: datetime
  label: Sample
  derivation: PC.PCDTC

  type: datetime
  label: First dose
  derivation: FIRSTDOSE.EXSTDTC
- name: PLTS
  type: int
  label: Planned seconds
  derivation:
    duration_value:
      source: PC.PCELTM
      unit: second

  type: datetime
  label: Window end
  derivation:
    shift:
      type: datetime
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: 4
      unit: hour
- name: AFRLT
  type: float
  label: Relative hours
  derivation:
    diff:
      type: datetime
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: hour

  type: int

  derivation:
    diff:
      type: datetime
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: second
- name: PLAN
  type: datetime
  label: Planned sample
  derivation:
    shift:
      type: datetime
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: PLTS
      unit: second
- name: INWIN
  type: str
  label: Within four hours
  derivation:
    flag:
      condition: ADTM >= FANLDTM and ADTM <= WINDOW
      false_value: N
      missing: null
